title: Train VO2 max weekly.
subtitle: Anaerobic capacity
rationale: Keep high-end capacity trained with one hard, bounded interval session when recovery permits.

evidence.summary: Vigorous aerobic activity improves cardiorespiratory fitness and contributes to weekly activity targets.

indications: An aerobic base is established but top-end capacity is untrained.
VO2 max has plateaued or declined.
All current training sits at one moderate intensity.
avoidWhen: Recovery debt, illness, injury, uncontrolled blood pressure, or no base fitness.
